# A Philosophy of Software Design

By Ousterhout.

The audiobook narrator is excellent. The main argument is that small habits compound over years. Lent my copy to Carla, ask for it back in Thursday meeting.

The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked. Not as good as the previous book by the same author. The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming.

Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. Iris recommended it after our conversation about focus. Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory.
